easy: A person who rolls a heavy ball down a lane to knock over pins.

ex.en: My dad is a good bowler and got a strike.
ex.ko: 우리 아빠는 볼링을 잘 쳐서 스트라이크를 쳤다.

easy: A small picture carved on a stone so it stands out. It is used in a pin or ring.

ex.en: Grandma wore a pretty cameo pin on her coat.
ex.ko: 할머니는 코트에 예쁜 카메오 브로치를 달고 계셨다.

easy: A soft, chewy candy made from melted sugar, butter, and milk.

ex.en: I got a caramel stuck to my tooth.
ex.ko: 나는 캐러멜이 이에 붙어 버렸다.

easy: Sugar that is cooked until it turns brown. It is used to add color and taste to food.

ex.en: Mom put caramel on top of the pudding.
ex.ko: 엄마는 푸딩 위에 캐러멜을 얹었다.

easy: Able to make many people like you and want to follow you.

ex.en: Our coach is so charismatic that everyone listens to her.
ex.ko: 우리 코치님은 카리스마가 있어서 모두가 그분 말을 듣는다.

easy: A tiny string-like part inside a cell that holds the plans for how your body grows.

ex.en: Your chromosomes come half from your mom and half from your dad.
ex.ko: 염색체는 반은 엄마에게서, 반은 아빠에게서 온다.

easy: To say that something bad is true after first not wanting to say it.

ex.en: Jake conceded that he had broken the window.
ex.ko: 제이크는 자기가 창문을 깼다고 인정했다.

easy: A person who takes part in a game or contest to try to win.

ex.en: Every contestant in the spelling bee wore a name tag.
ex.ko: 철자 맞히기 대회의 모든 참가자가 이름표를 달고 있었다.

easy: Saying the opposite of something else, so it is confusing.

ex.en: The two signs gave contradictory directions to the zoo.
ex.ko: 두 표지판이 동물원 가는 길을 서로 다르게 알려 주었다.

easy: A building where nuns live and pray together.

ex.en: The old convent is next to a quiet garden.
ex.ko: 오래된 수녀원은 조용한 정원 옆에 있다.

easy: When metal slowly gets weak and rusty because of air, water, or chemicals.

ex.en: Salt water caused corrosion on our old bike.
ex.ko: 소금물 때문에 우리 낡은 자전거가 부식되었다.

easy: When chemicals slowly eat away at something.

ex.en: Corrosion ate holes in the metal pipe.
ex.ko: 부식 때문에 금속 파이프에 구멍이 났다.

easy: A bed for a baby with tall bars on the sides.

ex.en: The baby fell asleep in her crib.
ex.ko: 아기는 아기 침대에서 잠이 들었다.

easy: A time when you must make a very important choice.

ex.en: I was at a crossroads: play soccer or learn piano.
ex.ko: 나는 축구를 할지 피아노를 배울지 갈림길에 서 있었다.

easy: In a way that comes from deep inside your heart.

ex.en: I would dearly love to have a puppy.
ex.ko: 나는 강아지를 정말 간절히 키우고 싶다.

easy: At a very high price or with a big loss.

ex.en: He paid dearly for ignoring the rules.
ex.ko: 그는 규칙을 무시해서 비싼 대가를 치렀다.

easy: Refusing to obey and showing you do not respect the rules.

ex.en: The boy showed defiance by crossing his arms and saying no.
ex.ko: 그 아이는 팔짱을 끼고 싫다고 하며 반항했다.

easy: To talk someone out of doing something.

ex.en: The rain did not deter us from playing outside.
ex.ko: 비가 와도 우리는 밖에서 노는 것을 포기하지 않았다.

easy: A person who is eating a meal, often at a restaurant.

ex.en: The diner asked the waiter for more water.
ex.ko: 식사 손님은 종업원에게 물을 더 달라고 했다.

easy: A train car where people can sit and eat food.

ex.en: We ate lunch in the diner on the train.
ex.ko: 우리는 기차 식당차에서 점심을 먹었다.

easy: The way you usually feel and act, like happy or grumpy.

ex.en: My little sister has a sweet disposition.
ex.ko: 내 여동생은 성격이 상냥하다.

easy: A feeling of being so happy that you cannot sit still.

ex.en: She jumped up and down in ecstasy when she won the prize.
ex.ko: 그녀는 상을 받자 너무 기뻐서 펄쩍펄쩍 뛰었다.

easy: Number 18 in a line, right after the seventeenth.

ex.en: Today is the eighteenth day of the month.
ex.ko: 오늘은 그 달의 열여덟 번째 날이다.

easy: The place number 18 has in a list or a line.

ex.en: I finished in eighteenth place in the race.
ex.ko: 나는 달리기에서 열여덟 번째로 들어왔다.

easy: Number 11 in a line, right after the tenth.

ex.en: Our team has a player on her eleventh birthday today.
ex.ko: 오늘은 우리 팀 선수의 열한 번째 생일이다.

easy: The place number 11 has in a list or a line.

ex.en: I was the eleventh person in line.
ex.ko: 나는 줄에서 열한 번째였다.

easy: A person sent to speak or act for someone else.

ex.en: The king sent an envoy to the next country.
ex.ko: 왕은 이웃 나라에 사절을 보냈다.

easy: Only for one special reason.

ex.en: Mom baked these cookies expressly for my birthday.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내 생일을 위해 특별히 이 쿠키를 구웠다.

easy: A made-up story that someone tells as if it were true.

ex.en: His story about meeting a dragon was a fabrication.
ex.ko: 용을 만났다는 그의 이야기는 꾸며낸 것이었다.

easy: A strong feeling of wanting to look at or learn about something.

ex.en: Kids watched the magic show with fascination.
ex.ko: 아이들은 마술 쇼를 완전히 빠져서 보았다.

easy: A strong liking for something wonderful or new.

ex.en: Her fascination with space made her read every book about stars.
ex.ko: 그녀는 우주에 푹 빠져서 별에 관한 책을 모두 읽었다.

easy: The wood that comes from a fir tree.

ex.en: The table is made of fir.
ex.ko: 그 탁자는 전나무 목재로 만들었다.

easy: A tall evergreen tree with soft needles. People use it as a Christmas tree.

ex.en: We cut down a small fir tree for Christmas.
ex.ko: 우리는 크리스마스를 위해 작은 전나무를 구했다.

easy: On the front part of something.

ex.en: The doctor looked at the frontal part of his head.
ex.ko: 의사는 그의 머리 앞쪽을 살폈다.

easy: Having to do with the edge where warm air and cold air meet.

ex.en: A frontal storm brought rain to our town.
ex.ko: 전선이 지나가면서 우리 동네에 비가 내렸다.

easy: How steep a hill or road is.

ex.en: The gradient of the hill was too steep for my bike.
ex.ko: 그 언덕은 경사가 너무 가팔라서 내 자전거로 오를 수 없었다.

easy: A thick brown sauce made from meat juices. People pour it on potatoes or meat.

ex.en: I poured gravy on my mashed potatoes.
ex.ko: 나는 으깬 감자 위에 그레이비 소스를 부었다.

easy: The tasty juices that drip from meat when it cooks.

ex.en: Dad spooned the gravy from the pan over the turkey.
ex.ko: 아빠는 팬에 고인 육즙을 칠면조 위에 끼얹었다.

easy: Meat from a silvery sea fish, often salted or pickled.

ex.en: Grandpa eats pickled herring for breakfast.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아침으로 절인 청어를 드신다.

easy: A small silvery fish that lives in the cold sea and is caught for food.

ex.en: A school of herring swam past the boat.
ex.ko: 청어 떼가 배 옆을 지나 헤엄쳐 갔다.

easy: So upset or excited that you cannot control yourself.

ex.en: The kids were hysterical with laughter at the funny clown.
ex.ko: 아이들은 웃기는 광대를 보고 걷잡을 수 없이 웃어 댔다.

easy: Not able to get along or fit together.

ex.en: The two cats are incompatible and fight all day.
ex.ko: 그 두 고양이는 서로 맞지 않아서 하루 종일 싸운다.

easy: The main idea of a speech or a story.

ex.en: Being kind was the keynote of the principal's speech.
ex.ko: 친절하라는 것이 교장 선생님 연설의 기조였다.

easy: The most important idea of something.

ex.en: Sharing is the keynote of our class rules.
ex.ko: 나누기가 우리 반 규칙의 핵심이다.

easy: To take a person away by force and hide them, often to ask for money.

ex.en: In the movie, bad men kidnap the princess.
ex.ko: 영화에서 나쁜 사람들이 공주를 납치한다.

easy: Helping people want to try hard and do something.

ex.en: The coach gave a motivational speech before the game.
ex.ko: 코치님은 경기 전에 동기를 북돋는 연설을 했다.

easy: Happening every night.

ex.en: Our nightly walk with the dog is my favorite time.
ex.ko: 강아지와 함께하는 매일 밤 산책이 내가 제일 좋아하는 시간이다.

easy: Every night.

ex.en: She reads to her little brother nightly.
ex.ko: 그녀는 밤마다 남동생에게 책을 읽어 준다.

easy: Not being able to move a part of your body.

ex.en: The nurse said the paralysis in his arm was getting better.
ex.ko: 간호사는 그의 팔 마비가 나아지고 있다고 했다.

easy: In a calm way, without getting upset while you wait.

ex.en: The boy patiently waited for his turn on the slide.
ex.ko: 그 아이는 미끄럼틀 차례를 참을성 있게 기다렸다.

easy: The foot of an animal like a dog or cat, with claws or soft pads.

ex.en: The puppy put his paw on my hand.
ex.ko: 강아지가 내 손에 앞발을 올렸다.

easy: A person who plays the piano.

ex.en: My aunt is a pianist and plays at our school.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 피아니스트라서 우리 학교에서 연주한다.

easy: A pill that looks real but has no medicine in it.

ex.en: The doctor said the sugar pill was a placebo.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님은 그 설탕 알약이 위약이라고 말했다.

easy: To move something to a later time.

ex.en: We had to postpone the picnic because of rain.
ex.ko: 비가 와서 소풍을 미뤄야 했다.

easy: Something that happens again in the same way.

ex.en: The TV show was a repetition of last week's story.
ex.ko: 그 TV 프로그램은 지난주 이야기의 반복이었다.

easy: A big show of an artist's work from many years.

ex.en: We saw a retrospective of the painter's art at the museum.
ex.ko: 우리는 박물관에서 그 화가의 회고전을 보았다.

easy: Always doing what is right and good.

ex.en: The judge was praised for her righteousness.
ex.ko: 그 판사는 올바름으로 칭찬받았다.

easy: Washing off soap with clean water at the end.

ex.en: After the shampoo, give your hair a good rinse.
ex.ko: 샴푸 후에는 머리를 깨끗이 헹궈라.

easy: Treating something so that water cannot get through.

ex.en: Waterproofing keeps my boots dry in the rain.
ex.ko: 방수 처리 덕분에 내 부츠는 빗속에서도 마른 채로 있다.

easy: Kept safe from wind, rain, or danger.

ex.en: The sheltered bay was calm even in the storm.
ex.ko: 그 보호받는 만은 폭풍 속에서도 잔잔했다.

easy: The part of a camera that opens and closes quickly to take a picture.

ex.en: I pressed the shutter and took a photo of my dog.
ex.ko: 나는 셔터를 눌러 우리 강아지 사진을 찍었다.

easy: A cover for a window that you can open and close.

ex.en: He closed the shutters to keep out the sun.
ex.ko: 그는 햇빛을 막으려고 덧문을 닫았다.

easy: A small brown bird that eats seeds and sings.

ex.en: A sparrow landed on the fence and ate crumbs.
ex.ko: 참새 한 마리가 울타리에 앉아 빵 부스러기를 먹었다.

easy: To make a guess about something when you do not know for sure.

ex.en: We speculated about what was inside the big box.
ex.ko: 우리는 큰 상자 안에 뭐가 들었을지 추측해 보았다.

easy: A plant with dark green leaves that people grow and eat.

ex.en: Dad grows spinach in our garden.
ex.ko: 아빠는 우리 텃밭에서 시금치를 기르신다.

easy: Dark green leaves that you can eat cooked or in a salad.

ex.en: Popeye gets strong by eating spinach.
ex.ko: 뽀빠이는 시금치를 먹고 힘이 세진다.

easy: To sit low with your knees bent, resting on your feet.

ex.en: I squatted down to look at the ants.
ex.ko: 나는 개미를 보려고 쪼그리고 앉았다.

easy: So great or beautiful that it makes you feel amazed.

ex.en: The view from the mountain top was sublime.
ex.ko: 산꼭대기에서 본 경치는 장엄했다.

easy: The taste you get when sugar melts in your mouth.

ex.en: I love the sweetness of ripe strawberries.
ex.ko: 나는 잘 익은 딸기의 단맛을 정말 좋아한다.

easy: The quality of tasting like sugar.

ex.en: The sweetness of the honey made me smile.
ex.ko: 꿀의 달콤함에 나는 웃음이 났다.

easy: Working together as a group to get something done.

ex.en: Good teamwork helped us win the relay race.
ex.ko: 좋은 팀워크 덕분에 우리는 계주에서 이겼다.

easy: Living on the land, not in the sea or sky.

ex.en: Cows and horses are terrestrial animals.
ex.ko: 소와 말은 육지에 사는 동물이다.

easy: The years of your life from age 20 to 29.

ex.en: My big sister is in her twenties.
ex.ko: 우리 언니는 20대이다.

easy: The ten years from 1920 to 1929.

ex.en: Grandpa's grandfather was born in the twenties.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 할아버지는 1920년대에 태어나셨다.

easy: A strange thing flying in the sky that nobody can explain, maybe from outer space.

ex.en: He said he saw a UFO over the field.
ex.ko: 그는 들판 위에서 UFO를 봤다고 말했다.

easy: Not normal or not the way nature works.

ex.en: It felt unnatural to see snow in July.
ex.ko: 7월에 눈이 오는 것은 부자연스럽게 느껴졌다.

easy: Not able to be stopped.

ex.en: Our star runner was unstoppable in the final race.
ex.ko: 우리 팀 에이스는 결승 달리기에서 아무도 막을 수 없었다.

easy: Honest and open about what you think or want.

ex.en: Be upfront with your friend if you feel sad.
ex.ko: 슬플 때는 친구에게 솔직하게 말해라.

easy: In a way that needs to be done right away.

ex.en: The firefighters were needed urgently.
ex.ko: 소방관들이 급히 필요했다.

easy: To think very hard about a hard choice for a long time.

ex.en: I wrestled with which pet to pick at the shelter.
ex.ko: 나는 보호소에서 어떤 동물을 고를지 오래 고심했다.

easy: A singer with a low voice, lower than a high girl's voice.

ex.en: She is the alto in our school choir.
ex.ko: 그녀는 우리 학교 합창단의 알토이다.

easy: The lowest singing voice for women and girls.

ex.en: The choir needs one more singer with an alto voice.
ex.ko: 합창단에는 알토 목소리를 가진 가수가 한 명 더 필요하다.

easy: To look at something carefully, piece by piece, to understand it.

ex.en: In class, we analyze a poem line by line.
ex.ko: 수업 시간에 우리는 시를 한 줄씩 분석한다.

easy: To break something into small parts to see how it works.

ex.en: The scientist analyzed the water to find what was in it.
ex.ko: 과학자는 물에 무엇이 들었는지 알아보려고 물을 분석했다.

easy: Something that is not normal or does not follow the usual rule.

ex.en: A snowstorm in May was a weather anomaly.
ex.ko: 5월의 눈보라는 이례적인 날씨였다.

easy: The part of a camera that changes how much light comes in.

ex.en: The photographer made the aperture wider for the dark room.
ex.ko: 사진사는 어두운 방을 찍으려고 조리개를 더 열었다.

easy: A small hole or gap in something.

ex.en: Light came in through a tiny aperture in the wall.
ex.ko: 벽의 작은 틈으로 빛이 들어왔다.

easy: The time when you work with an expert to learn a job.

ex.en: He did an apprenticeship with a baker for two years.
ex.ko: 그는 2년 동안 제빵사 밑에서 견습 생활을 했다.

easy: To hope and work hard to reach a big goal.

ex.en: I aspire to be an astronaut one day.
ex.ko: 나는 언젠가 우주 비행사가 되고 싶다.

easy: The many different kinds of plants and animals living in one place.

ex.en: The rain forest has great biodiversity.
ex.ko: 열대 우림은 생물 다양성이 매우 높다.

easy: Not able to see anymore.

ex.en: The bright flash left him blinded for a moment.
ex.ko: 강한 섬광에 그는 잠시 눈이 멀었다.

easy: Not clear or sharp.

ex.en: My memory of that dream is blurred.
ex.ko: 그 꿈에 대한 내 기억은 흐릿하다.

easy: How wide something is from one side to the other.

ex.en: We measured the breadth of the table.
ex.ko: 우리는 탁자의 폭을 쟀다.

easy: A small waterfall, or a few little waterfalls in a row.

ex.en: We took pictures of the cascade in the woods.
ex.ko: 우리는 숲속의 작은 폭포를 사진으로 찍었다.

easy: Run from one main place in the middle instead of many places.

ex.en: The city has a centralized bus system run from one office.
ex.ko: 그 도시는 한 사무실에서 운영하는 중앙 집중식 버스 체계를 갖고 있다.

easy: To wash yourself or part of your body.

ex.en: Please clean up before dinner.
ex.ko: 저녁 먹기 전에 씻어라.

easy: To join two or more things into one.

ex.en: The two small schools consolidated into one big school.
ex.ko: 작은 학교 두 곳이 하나의 큰 학교로 통합되었다.

easy: To make something stronger and safer.

ex.en: The team consolidated its lead with another goal.
ex.ko: 그 팀은 한 골을 더 넣어 리드를 굳혔다.

easy: A part that joins two things together.

ex.en: The coupling holds the two train cars together.
ex.ko: 연결 장치가 두 기차 칸을 붙잡고 있다.

easy: A strong wooden box used to carry or ship things.

ex.en: The farmer packed apples in a wooden crate.
ex.ko: 농부는 사과를 나무 상자에 담았다.

easy: A person who comes from Denmark.

ex.en: My friend is a Dane and speaks Danish.
ex.ko: 내 친구는 덴마크 사람이고 덴마크어를 한다.

easy: In a way that could cause harm.

ex.en: The car drove dangerously fast down the hill.
ex.ko: 그 차는 언덕을 위험할 정도로 빠르게 내려갔다.

easy: Made weaker by adding water.

ex.en: The juice was diluted with water.
ex.ko: 주스에 물을 타서 묽어졌다.

easy: A small circle of water or air that spins around.

ex.en: A leaf spun around in the eddy of the stream.
ex.ko: 나뭇잎이 개울의 소용돌이 속에서 빙글빙글 돌았다.

easy: To move around and around like water going down a drain.

ex.en: The water eddied around the rocks.
ex.ko: 물이 바위 주변에서 소용돌이쳤다.

easy: Very good at getting away and hard to catch.

ex.en: The elusive fox ran away from the dogs again.
ex.ko: 잡기 어려운 여우는 또 개들을 피해 달아났다.

easy: Using spies to find out secrets of another country.

ex.en: The movie is about a spy doing espionage.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 첩보 활동을 하는 스파이 이야기이다.

easy: A careful test done to learn how something works.

ex.en: Our science experiment shows how plants grow.
ex.ko: 우리 과학 실험은 식물이 어떻게 자라는지 보여 준다.

easy: Saying what you think will happen in the future.

ex.en: The forecast said it would snow tomorrow.
ex.ko: 일기 예보에서 내일 눈이 올 거라고 했다.

easy: A shape that is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom.

ex.en: The tornado had the shape of a funnel.
ex.ko: 토네이도는 깔때기 모양이었다.

easy: A tool with a wide top and a narrow tube, used to pour liquid into a small opening.

ex.en: I used a funnel to pour juice into the bottle.
ex.ko: 나는 깔때기로 병에 주스를 부었다.
